CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_dashboard_metrics()
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  result json;
  kpi_total int;
  kpi_new_week int;
  kpi_engagement text;
  
  -- Variáveis para loops
  p_metrics json;
  
  -- Agregadores
  origins_data json;
  alerts_data json;
begin
  -- 1. KPIs GERAIS
  select count(*) into kpi_total from clients;
  
  select count(*) into kpi_new_week 
  from clients 
  where created_at > (now() - interval '7 days');
  
  -- Engajamento simplificado
  select 
    coalesce(round((count(*) filter (where updated_at > now() - interval '30 days')::numeric / nullif(count(*),0)::numeric) * 100, 0), 0) || '%'
  into kpi_engagement
  from clients;

  -- 2. ORIGENS (Top 5)
  select json_agg(t) into origins_data from (
    select coalesce(origin, 'Não informado') as name, count(*) as value
    from clients
    group by origin
    order by count(*) desc
    limit 5
  ) t;

  -- 3. ALERTAS (Lógica de Negócio)
  select json_agg(a) into alerts_data from (
    -- Alerta Vendas: Propostas paradas
    select 'Vendas' as sector, count(*) || ' propostas sem interação há > 2 dias' as message, 'red' as color
    from clients c
    join pipeline_stages s on c.stage_id = s.id
    where lower(s.name) like '%proposta%' 
    and c.updated_at < (now() - interval '2 days')
    group by 1, 3
    
    union all
    
    -- Alerta Locação: Visitas para confirmar
    select 'Locação', count(*) || ' visitas pendentes de feedback', 'yellow'
    from clients c
    join pipeline_stages s on c.stage_id = s.id
    where lower(s.name) like '%visita%'
    and c.updated_at < (now() - interval '1 day')
    group by 1, 3
  ) a;

  -- 4. MÉTRICAS POR SETOR (PIPELINE)
  select json_agg(pipeline_data) into result from (
    select 
      p.id,
      p.name,
      (
        select json_build_object(
          'total_leads', count(*),
          'total_value', coalesce(sum(deal_value), 0),
          'ticket_average', coalesce(round(avg(deal_value), 2), 0),
          
          -- Vistoria: Taxa de Realização (FIX: nullif(..., 0))
          'execution_rate', case 
            when lower(p.name) like '%vistoria%' then
              coalesce(round((count(*) filter (where lower(s.name) in ('realizada', 'concluída'))::numeric / nullif(count(*), 0)::numeric) * 100, 0), 0)
            else 0 
          end,
          
          -- Vendas: Conversão Proposta -> Venda (FIX: nullif(..., 0))
          'conversion_rate', case 
            when lower(p.name) like '%vendas%' then
              coalesce(round((count(*) filter (where s.is_final_success)::numeric / nullif(count(*), 0)::numeric) * 100, 1), 0)
            else 0
          end,

          -- Financiamento: Taxa Aprovação (FIX: nullif(..., 0))
          'approval_rate', case 
            when lower(p.name) like '%financiamento%' then
              coalesce(round((count(*) filter (where s.is_final_success)::numeric / nullif(count(*), 0)::numeric) * 100, 0), 0)
            else 0
          end,
          
          -- Locação: Ativos
          'active_count', count(*) filter (where not s.is_final_failure)
        )
        from clients c
        join pipeline_stages s on c.stage_id = s.id
        where c.pipeline_id = p.id
      ) as metrics
    from pipelines p
  ) pipeline_data;

  -- Montar JSON Final (Tratando nulos)
  return json_build_object(
    'kpis', json_build_object(
      'total', coalesce(kpi_total, 0),
      'new_week', coalesce(kpi_new_week, 0),
      'engagement', coalesce(kpi_engagement, '0%')
    ),
    'pipelines', coalesce(result, '[]'::json),
    'origins', coalesce(origins_data, '[]'::json),
    'alerts', coalesce(alerts_data, '[]'::json)
  );
end;
